description: Check whether a phone number is confirmed for calls from Rymi's shared test lines, for the API key's user. Read-only. confirmed false means start_test_number_confirmation is still required, or the phone has not sent the WhatsApp message yet. Does not confirm the number.

workspace.description: Act in this workspace, e.g. one of your client workspaces (id from list_workspaces). Default: the workspace this connection uses.

name: get_test_number_confirmation
